sections.title: Text effects, markup and modifiers
sections.intro:
Text effects move or color each glyph: JOID ships the `ITextEffect` interface, and the effects and the markup of these cards are written like the ones in [Text markup and effects](/use/learn/describing-the-ui/text-markup-and-effects/).
Text modifiers change the characters before layout.

sections.title: Cursors
sections.intro:
The cursor shapes a node asks for with `cursor(...)`; the operating system draws them, so their look follows the system.
[Hover and tooltips](/use/learn/interactivity/hover-and-tooltips/) shows how a node asks for one.

cards.name: POINTER
cards.text: A hand: something that reacts to a click.

cards.name: TEXT
cards.text: An I-beam: text that you select or type.

cards.name: CROSSHAIR
cards.text: A cross: a precise point to pick.

cards.name: MOVE
cards.text: Four arrows: something that you move.

cards.name: NOT_ALLOWED
cards.text: A crossed circle: an action that is refused here.

cards.name: RESIZE_EW
cards.text: A left-right arrow: a horizontal resize.

cards.name: RESIZE_NS
cards.text: An up-down arrow: a vertical resize.

cards.name: RESIZE_NWSE
cards.text: A diagonal arrow from the top left to the bottom right: a corner resize.

cards.name: RESIZE_NESW
cards.text: A diagonal arrow from the top right to the bottom left: a corner resize.
